description: Supplement of 'Control of the Power Flows of a Stochastic Power System’ is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Zhen Wang (School of Mathematics, Shandong University, Jinan, 250100, Shandong Province, China). The purpose of this supplement is to provide the direct outcomes of the proposed procedure for the three examples investigated in the main body of the paper. The exit probabilities from the safe subset $(-pi/2, \pi/2)$ are computed according to the numerical result of our proposed procedure of each power line. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
